fields.value: Fix transfer and reporting defects found in eb2edc's paid L4 run

Problem: eb2edc's paid validation (four RunPod L4 rentals, 2026-10-26/27, about $1.06) exposed five launcher defects unrelated to its scope. Evidence is in the eb2edc checkout (/Users/jack/src/etude.eb2edc-reuse-prepared-runtimes, scratch/eb2edc-reuse-prepared-runtimes.md, 'Results'). Copy what you need into this Task's checkout before starting.

1. Courier uploads use one connection and block the courier loop while uploading. A 7 GB archive took about 9.5 min (12 MB/s), and staging 19.3 GB of weights took about 20 min.
2. A cancel is ignored while the courier is fetching inputs.
3. Downloads read only one range ahead. Stragglers of up to 76 s drain the pipeline, so Etude reaches 48-81 MB/s against about 207 MB/s for s5cmd on the same rental (R2 to L4, 19.3 GB).
4. etude machines --all shows the wrong billed amount ($0.0440 and $0.0401 for rentals that lasted 33.6 and 34.5 min at $0.59/h).
5. etude usage --run prints the whole events JSON before its summary.

Outcome: each defect fixed or explicitly deferred with a reason. Counting tests cover the transfer paths (connections and calls, never timings). Never induce load. Uploads/downloads go through etude/cache.py; no second cache. Any paid re-measurement needs its own declared hardware, hours, cost cap, cleanup and attempt limit, under an authorization granted for this Task.

Requested by Jack Heart on 2026-10-27 in the eb2edc conversation, grouped as one Task.
